name: 粘朝益
objective:
課程為可程式控制基礎課程之延伸，著重於 PLC 進階應用與自動化控制系統整合。內容涵蓋電控系統設計、I/O 規劃、先進梯形圖程式撰寫、感測器與致動元件整合、氣壓控制應用、以及設備除錯與優化。透過實務導向的專題製作，使學生能利用 PLC、人機界面、工業配線與控制邏輯等技術，完成小型自動化控制系統之開發。課程強調 學、做合一，以考取勞動部機電整合丙級技術士技能檢定為主要訓練目標。
This course is an extension of the introductory programmable control course and focuses on advanced PLC applications and automation system integration. The course content includes electrical control system design, I/O planning, advanced ladder logic programming, integration of sensors and actuators, pneumatic control applications, as well as troubleshooting and optimization of equipment. Through practice-oriented project implementation, students will apply PLC programming, HMI development, industrial wiring, and control logic techniques to develop small-scale automated control systems. The course emphasizes learning by doing and aims to prepare students for passing the Level C Mechatronics Integration Technician Skill Certification administered by the Ministry of Labor.

W1：理解機電整合丙級術科檢定流程與評分方式
W2：能依圖完成控制電路配線、線號標示與端子壓接

W4：組裝氣動元件，並整合 PLC 控制完成動作循環
W5：具備安全作業、問題排除與自我檢核能力
